parameters.relayBrief: planning v1.0.0 — EDD PLANNING — a frozen upstream artifact becomes an enforced, buildable plan: FRAME → CARVE → SEQUENCE → DISPATCH.

parameters.title: Intake
parameters.instructions: Classify every input by provenance, declare authority and the two decision rights, bind upstream, answer the campaign question.

parameters.title: Bearings
parameters.instructions: The repo's enforced gates, the honest baseline, tiered blast-radius impact with depth, defect reproduction state, characterization pinning.

parameters.title: Terms
parameters.instructions: Source-quoted requirements, acceptance that resolves to commands, full stories with rung and enactment, dated questions, the read-back.

parameters.title: FRAMED gate
parameters.instructions: plan-check --phase frame: the FRAME artifact validates and its evidence is present.

parameters.title: Carve
parameters.instructions: Partition requirements over closers into smallest-mergeable packages; pin allow-lists with tiers and undo; derive conflict_pairs and hotspots.

parameters.title: Size
parameters.instructions: Grade each package against the session-horizon and branch-age constants; split oversized ones; record each sizing claim as a falsifiable prediction.

parameters.title: CARVED gate
parameters.instructions: plan-check --phase carve: packages partition the requirements, scopes resolve, conflict pairs computed from intersections.

parameters.title: Waits
parameters.instructions: Every wait with owner, duration, basis and escalation; each rung walked through enablement into enablers or downgrades; obligations that outlive merge.

parameters.title: Order
parameters.instructions: Dependency edges, contracts frozen before dependents, parallel sets bounded by disjointness with hotspots and T3 floor serialized.

parameters.title: Forecast
parameters.instructions: most_likely and range with each duration's basis, the wait share, assumptions wired to questions or tripwires, commitment_type within authority.

parameters.title: SEQUENCED gate
parameters.instructions: plan-check --phase sequence: order acyclic and justified, rungs enabled or downgraded, waits owned, forecast has basis and wait share.

parameters.title: Policy
parameters.instructions: Repair/no-progress/escalation/branch-age/check-tier constants become every builder's operating rules; this work's ambiguity defaults from the frame's questions.

parameters.title: Packets
parameters.instructions: One self-contained work order per package: stories inlined with enactments, red-first, anchors verified against the repo, acceptance split from ledger-held checks.

parameters.title: Hostile read
parameters.instructions: A cold reviewer works the refute-first question set against the frozen artifacts; routes no-requirement discoveries per law 11; lists residual doubts. Emits the verdict object.

parameters.title: Tripwires
parameters.instructions: Arm the six standard falsification wires plus any claim-specific ones from signals the repo and ledger already emit; wire every frame assumption to its reopen consequence.

parameters.title: FROZEN gate
parameters.instructions: plan-check --phase dispatch: packets self-contained, holdout separated and covering, hostile_read APPROVE, tripwires armed. Freezes the plan.

nodeGroups.name: FRAME
nodeGroups.description:
## Macro FRAME — EDD planning protocol

Load `docs/edd/planning-protocol.md@sha256:41808c99e71d` (the FRAME rows and the
Definitions it depends on) and `docs/edd/doctrine.md` (the evidence ladder, the
stakes procedure, the independence rules). Their MUST clauses bind; do NOT restate
them here — this prompt only routes.

The frozen upstream artifact (or, standalone, the raw task) arrives as
`initial_context`. Read it in full before writing anything.

Sub-states run in order: intake → bearings → terms → framed (gate). For the current
sub-state, load and follow its dispatch prompt and invoke its skill:
  - intake:   docs/edd/prompts/planning/01-intake.md    · skill plan-frame
  - bearings: docs/edd/prompts/planning/02-bearings.md  · skill plan-bearings
  - terms:    docs/edd/prompts/planning/03-terms.md     · skill plan-terms
Each emits its owned fields of `plan/frame.json` against
`docs/edd/templates/planning/frame.tmpl.json`.

The `framed` gate is mechanical: run `docs/edd/tools/plan-check --phase frame` and
submit each criterion below as evidence only when its PASS line is present. A gate is
not a formality — a criterion you cannot make pass is a FRAME defect, not a checkbox
to assert.

nodeGroups.name: CARVE
nodeGroups.description:
## Macro CARVE — EDD planning protocol

Load `docs/edd/planning-protocol.md@sha256:41808c99e71d` (the CARVE rows, the
Scope-tiers and Hotspot definitions). MUST clauses bind; do not restate.

Consume `plan/frame.json` (frozen by FRAME). Sub-states run in order:
carve → size → carved (gate). For the current sub-state, load its dispatch prompt and
skill:
  - carve: docs/edd/prompts/planning/05-carve.md · skill plan-carve
  - size:  docs/edd/prompts/planning/06-size.md  · skill plan-size
They emit `plan/packages.json` against `docs/edd/templates/planning/packages.tmpl.json`.
conflict_pairs and hotspots are COMPUTED at the carve transition (run
`docs/edd/tools/plan-graph --conflict`), never asserted.

The `carved` gate is mechanical: `docs/edd/tools/plan-check --phase carve`.

nodeGroups.name: SEQUENCE
nodeGroups.description:
## Macro SEQUENCE — EDD planning protocol

Load `docs/edd/planning-protocol.md@sha256:41808c99e71d` (the SEQUENCE rows, the
enablement table, the Constants table). MUST clauses bind; do not restate. This macro
runs only when there is more than one package; a single-package plan renders the short
form and its sub-states collapse to the wait register.

Consume `plan/packages.json`. Sub-states run in order: waits → order → forecast →
sequenced (gate). Load each sub-state's dispatch prompt and skill:
  - waits:    docs/edd/prompts/planning/08-waits.md    · skill plan-waits
  - order:    docs/edd/prompts/planning/09-order.md    · skill plan-order
  - forecast: docs/edd/prompts/planning/10-forecast.md · skill plan-forecast
They emit `plan/sequence.json` against `docs/edd/templates/planning/sequence.tmpl.json`
(order via `docs/edd/tools/plan-graph --order`).

The `sequenced` gate is mechanical: `docs/edd/tools/plan-check --phase sequence`.

nodeGroups.name: DISPATCH
nodeGroups.description:
## Macro DISPATCH — EDD planning protocol

Load `docs/edd/planning-protocol.md@sha256:41808c99e71d` (the DISPATCH rows) and
`docs/edd/doctrine.md` (holdout, independence). MUST clauses bind; do not restate.

Consume `plan/frame.json`, `plan/packages.json`, `plan/sequence.json`. Sub-states run
in order: policy → packets → hostile_read → tripwires → frozen (gate). Load each
sub-state's dispatch prompt and skill:
  - policy:       docs/edd/prompts/planning/12-policy.md        · skill plan-policy
  - packets:      docs/edd/prompts/planning/13-packets.md       · skill plan-packet
  - hostile_read: docs/edd/prompts/planning/14-hostile-read.md  · skill plan-hostile-read
  - tripwires:    docs/edd/prompts/planning/15-tripwires.md     · skill plan-tripwires
They emit `plan/manifest.json` (policy, packets, holdout, tripwires) and the
hostile-read verdict object.

hostile_read runs in a COLD context: a fresh session or a second agent holding only the
frozen artifacts, never the context that wrote the plan. If you produced this plan in
this context you are disqualified from reviewing it — spawn a fresh one. A FIXES-NEEDED
verdict loops DISPATCH; it does not pass. Solo, record `reviewer: operator`.

The `frozen` gate is mechanical: `docs/edd/tools/plan-check --phase dispatch`. It
freezes the plan — what BUILD consumes.
